Name: StateU LIF_Sample LDE Target Test
Description: Maps every StateU LIF attribute that at least one demo test user actually populates, as seen in the record the Query Planner composes for the LDE, into the Sample LDE Target Test model. Import with POST /transformation_groups/{id}/import; the numeric '<id>:' prefixes inside every EntityIdPath are ignored, paths resolve by UniqueName.
Notes: See docs/reference/transformations/README.md for the manual verification steps.
